steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Her very first time entering a knight competition, Viviana Droste earned a title; 'Glimmer' Viviana. Three years later, with her Major debut, she became one of the Grands, taking on the honorific title 'The Candle Knight.'

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: In terms of talent, she's the youngest any of the ten Grand Knights have ever been. In terms of strength, hers is still growing to this day. She can't be taken lightly.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Margaret, are you listening?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Yes. I'm just reminiscing some.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Auntie, is this like how you and Margaret... used to take on the Major?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Well, if you want to talk then... heheh.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: A certain someone always vanished after a match ended, either holing up in her room studying deep into her next opponent's traits, or secretly running off to train her swordhand with Młynar...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: I still remember us all agreeing to celebrate with a feast the first time Margaret won, and in the end she let it completely slip her mind.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: When we found her, she was dragging her battered body, attempting her own Arts in the garden.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: I did want to ask right then, aren't you freezing?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: It was because my Arts can alleviate pain, too, so...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: So ultimately it's not proper treatment, or else what value would modern medicine even have?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Heheh... I won't argue with that.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I know many a doctor that would astonish you. It's thanks to their invaluable techniques that rescuing others is no longer a far-fetched notion.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Rhodes Island Pharmaceuticals? Or was it those two Sarkaz women?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Both. They're all in the fight against suffering.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Come to mention it, Miss Shining and Miss Nightingale went to link up with friends from Rhodes Island, didn't they?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I'm not sure how they're doing right now.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: No matter if they're in the Grand Knight Territory, they're still giving all they have to assist the Infected. I believe in them.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: But what I myself must do is unrelated to Rhodes Island's will. I can't force this responsibility upon them.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Hence why I separated from Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Margaret... take a little care of yourself too, when you can.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: There's something fine for you to say. If you want to talk mess, Maria, you've been SO much worse.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: ...Haha...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Alright—anyhow.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: What's the plan of action now? I don't think training would have much meaning to you now, personally speaking.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: But this is your first time in years facing a Grand Knight. Should we have a little exercise, get back to peak condition?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: If you would, Zofia.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Brilliant.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Maria, you're up.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Er, um? I thought I was fine to just sit and watch?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Sit and watch? I didn't ask you to bring your equipment for no reason, did I? Didn't you see what happened last time? Do you want me taking the Radiant Knight alone again?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Ungh...

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Zofia, if she isn't willing...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: And don't you coddle her!

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Very well.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: A—Am I sparring with Margaret? I've never...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: When Margaret was competing, you were just a little girl. Though you still are now.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Maria.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Yes, yes!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Let's give our Radiant Knight a little taste of how independent knight, Maria Nearl, toppled Left-hand Knight.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Okay!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Alright, Margaret... let's go!

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Very well.
Meeting Maria's gaze, the words of a certain someone suddenly pop into the Radiant Knight's mind.

a.text: Has she renounced... the path of knighthood?
Was it I—who made her give it up?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: I'm aware, I'm aware... the scheduling for next week's meeting is already in place. Yes. I will not be absent.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: I assure you I'll see the work delegated to me through. Yes, I'm very sorry. No... it's nothing to do with the Radiant Knight. I remain an employee of the company. I'll accomplish whatever business is at hand.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: It has absolutely nothing to do with my status. Sir, please leave me out of this mockery. They're unrelated matters and nothing else...

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Thank you. Alright, I'll see you next week at the meeting.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Someone's a singleton, huh?

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Is this what the Radiant Knight and her sister do too? Never come back home?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Toland. I've warned you, don't set foot on my carpet whenever you please.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: The Armorless Union's eye is firmly fixed upon you. Are you planning to drag me down alongside?

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Now that's beyond my wildest dreams. Relax. As long as they don't fold their big slippery kill-men in, how are a bunch of armed lackeys ever gonna track me down?

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: I'm not winning in a fight, this city's their turf. But if they want to catch me, they'll have to show they want it.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Are you asking me to praise your audacity?

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Now that'd be something else. A high knight praising me, some lowlife? I wouldn't carry that weight, would I?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: I am no longer a knight.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Not even today, with the Radiant Knight getting her title back?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Shamelessness.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Why are you here?

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: C'mon, I didn't come to the Grand Knight Territory just for you, Mister Knightsir... but in seriousness, if I could talk you into lending a hand to us, that'd be a fine, fine thing.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: I regretfully inform you, this matter is already settled.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Even though I've given a hundred percent to protecting your little Nearl nieces?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Even then.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Alright, fine.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Maybe you really have changed. Młynar. I'm just giving you a heads up...

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: I passed by the border of Kawalerielki today. Those districts were originally a city of their own, right?

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: You still remember the sight we saw when we came back to the GKT together, back when we were young?

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Miles of camps outside the city knocked together by the refugees and the poor, bonfires in the evening lighting up the faces of the homeless.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Infected, bandits, farmers, workers, even knight nobility thrown to the beasts. If tragedy was a melting pot, there it melted.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: The sobbing and the anger all mixing together. Even as people to the side are being robbed and killed, they just shuffle their bodies around and try to give themselves a better sleep.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Ha... I know you wouldn't forget. I know you... you've just been angry for too long, lost hope.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: I won't need you to help me decide.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: The Armorless Union is cleaning out the Infected's haunt tonight. The coordinates are on this sheet.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: And what do the Infected knights... have to do with me?

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Oh, Kazimierz is loaded with ways to treat the Infected. Even if they drive them to take each other's lives like gladiators, they still beat Ursus by a long shot.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: —But the workers infected in the building of the city, the farmers infected when they couldn't escape Catastrophe, and the survivors struggling so they can become knights?

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: They'll die like wretches before your eyes. What the Infected will go through will directly impact how public opinion determines the Radiant Knight. And then, in the end, everything you love will be swept into the storm that follows.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: You don't need to threaten me.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: What about you, then?

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: I'll help out a bit, 'as I feel it.' If it really comes down to it, I might risk my neck a little.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Pinus Sylvestris is an important potential partner of ours, and I want to pull them in with us. Ha, sure, they're Infected, but they're big fancy knights, just like you, aren't they?

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: And that's about that... I'll give you a final touch of advice, Młynar.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: The big picture's coming together. Staying out of it won't get you anywhere, anymore.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: All present, then?

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Since when did you have so many people?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: However many knights have been oppressed, are however many knights here.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Drop the idea that you're the only one who's suffered and wants to rebel, Szewczyk.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: 'Plastic' Szewczyk. I've got no prejudice against pets of the General Chamber like you, but I can't say how happy I am, still seeing some will to rebel in your eyes.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Everyone still has a trace of it. The unwillingness to drift with the tide.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Hah! Drifting with the tide's one thing, but this swell's gonna beat us dead clear as day in the darkest dump around! And that's sure as hell not their call to make!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: The plan's very simple.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Three years ago, on the day before that Major, the moment the four cities were about to link up, the core city power plant got paralyzed by terrorists.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: In order to merge smoothly, each district already had its own engines shut off. When the core city's power dropped out of them in that state, every district was forced to switch over to their independent power systems, which included their cities' engines.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: At that point, in order to stop the districts colliding, the Grand Knight Territory was forced to completely scatter apart.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: The Great Kawalerielki Separation.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Yep.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: But this time, while the Major's on, we're going to completely cut the lights in all the Grand Knight Territory's arenas.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: I've heard it multiple times and it still sounds crazy. Can we really pull this off all on our own?

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: If the Grand Knight Territory fell this easy, then Ursus would've razed Kazimierz to the ground ages ago.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Does this tie in with your... 'Sprawiedliwi friends?'

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Strange. The Adeptus allowing the Separation to rear its scandalous head again? What are they calculating?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Hah, what, the biggest scandal wasn't getting rode out by the business suits?

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: What's the specific plan?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Tomorrow evening, Greynuty's taking a team to shock-attack the Grand Knight Territory power plant.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Ordinarily, it's heavily guarded down there, but on this occasion, the Adeptus are gonna deliberately leave an opening... to give us 'something to exploit.'

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: If the Adeptus are willing to help us so much, why don't they just do this themselves?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Haha, they don't exactly speak in unity. Not just the Adeptus, the law-and-order National Council, the Knights Association, even the General Chamber of Commerce...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: We've seen our fair shares of the volatile human condition. Since when would they ever be so simple?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Justyna, you go with Ashley.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: After you complete your mission, cover them while they withdraw, then rush for the General Chamber building three kilometers out. Szewczyk'll be there to back you up at the designated spot.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: As for you, Iwona, you're gonna have to handle the Armorless Union.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Aha, just what I wanted to hear!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: The Armorless are already watching this place, so we won't get to pull this off so smooth. You've gotta find some way to proactively get them into a fight, Iwona, draw their attention away.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Of course, if any 'elites' show up, you've gotta hit the brakes, turn tail, and scram.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Got it.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: The next time we hold a celebration dinner, I don't want your seat empty. I'll have no one to drink with, otherwise.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Relax. As long as you don't mess up and electrocute yourself, I'll keep with you to the bitter end.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Finally... with the help of a few conscientious reporters, we've found a passage to infiltrate the General Chamber of Commerce.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: The entrance to the Chamber building's freight elevator is underground. Usually it's only Messengers and porters that go through there—

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: —Of course, even a freight elevator has its cameras. It won't be as easy as that.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: But at the time of the last Great Kawalerielki Separation, with the power out, a Messenger trapped in the elevator escaped by himself, then got caught by a reporter for an interview—

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: He got into the elevator well through the air vent, climbed up, all the way to the fourth floor meeting rooms.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Our objective's the penthouse computer room. Once we steal the data, I'll find a way to immediately upload it to your terminals, and all of you can get the material—

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: —So that this'll work, even if you don't make it out?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: You can't tell me anything of the sort, Sona. I'm disappointed in you. Even if it succeeds, this operation won't mean anything at all.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Not just you.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Assaulting the power facilities. Facing the Armorless Union. Not a single aspect of this is safe.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: You want 'safety' now? Hmph, if the Armorless really do send assassins for us, it'll be nothing but playing hunter.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: And moreover, we're certain to be the prey. Anyone who's not prepared for this, I suggest you back out right now. Don't drag us down when the time comes.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: We have no way out in the first place, Sir Knight.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: We were prepared for this long ago, because we never even needed to prepare.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: What we genuinely need amounts to two things.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: The truth of Area 0—the cage for the Infected secretly built by the General Chamber—we need to let the whole world know about it.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: And the Armorless Union's 'roster.' To put it in perspective, even the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi doesn't know how many are on that list... In the worst-case scenario, it'll all have been a ruse set up by those spymasters in the first place.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Even so, as long as we succeed in handing these two things over to the Adeptus, we can get our legal papers back... and we won't ever be anyone else's playthings again.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: As long as we give the Adeptus a reasonable motive to investigate Area 0 and the Armorless Union, it'll be the best attack they could ever make on the General Chamber of Commerce.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Win or lose, this is the moment.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Alright! I like those looks in your eyes!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Well then... anything weighing on you, Toland Cash?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: You ought to show your face after eavesdropping for so long, right? Iwona's told us already. We won't pull anything on you.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: It's a bold plan. Infected and knightpeople, pleased to meet you.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: A bounty hunter? Flametail, you never mentioned an outsider like this taking part in the fight.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: You can't stand bounty hunters? Very sorry, but I've got my own share of hate for knights—

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: But I imagine the fancy knights know to take stock of a situation, especially ones like you, giving up your knighthood for your family. Factually admirable, I tell you.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: So what I think, is that maybe you might need a little help in other ways—no, that's fine if you don't trust me—for example, a blueprint of the K.G.C.C. Tower's internal structure.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Where did you get it?

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: There's more ways than you know, Miss, but human connections work best.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: If you want to join in on us, fine. But. Hm, just as an interview, I want to hear your reasons.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Reasons?

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Ahh... you can already see the K.G.C.C. building from this angle. It's one you can catch from any dim alley in the Grand Knight Territory.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: I want to see it crumble. It's that simple.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Have you ever been to one of those villages hammered by taxation and Catastrophes?

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: I've been. I see them fight over things. I see them run fugitive. I see them pass on.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: I've been to many a place.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: It sounds like you've got plentiful experience.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Hah, don't look at me. I thought he was a decent sight from the beginning, right?

steps.name: 'Justice Knight'
steps.text: (A beeping noise)

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: No objection.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: It's your call.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Alright, then. Welcome to the club, Mr. Toland.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ah... mm, I'm alright. All the Medic Operators have been hard at work too.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The Infected knights... I thought they were a special case in Kazimierz, but they number far more than I imagined.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: They even have scarring from beast bites... it's precisely because of this that ordinary hospitals are so hesitant to accept wounded Infected for treatment.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: However...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No... I can't shake this feeling that something, somewhere isn't normal.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: There's nothing wrong with building an Infected treatment facility in an isolated district, but the people who've accepted treatment, they've all been 'knights'...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If it were just for handling Infected knights, they shouldn't have needed to go to so much trouble.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What I mean is... there might be quite a few Infected knights... but how many people—is this nomadic platform able to contain?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The other sections... the workers won't let us near them, but what are those areas—doing?

options: I'll ask Gravel if she knows anything.
You need to get some rest first.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Alright!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Don't push yourself too hard, Doctor. The Adeptus Sprawiedliwi's knights might be treating us politely thanks to our ties with Miss Nearl, but this is still Kazimierz's core in the end.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That's right, where's Gravel? Wasn't she staying at your side?

options: I asked her for some company info from the K.G.C.C.
If I can, I want a meeting with the spokespeople and our partners.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ah... but given you're the one requesting it...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, you have to be careful when you're dealing with those businesspeople.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I've been hearing of all sorts of rumors from the knights these past few days...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ah, that's right, I heard about Nearl's performance! Quite a few of the Infected knights coming for treatment are fans of hers!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'd known 'The Radiant Knight' held weight in Kazimierz, but never imagined this scale.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I hear Nearl's sister's old enough to fight in the knight competitions, so actually she must be older than me, even... if we get the chance, I'd really like to meet her.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Amiya! You're here too, Doctor!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ah, Hibiscus. Any news?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Well... it's a little hard for me to put... um.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: The knights who came in today were talking about 'demonic treatment,' 'the shady doctor from Kazdel' and the like...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: We wouldn't... advertise like that, would we? To be honest, it should be 'the health administering maestro from Kazdel' anyway!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I—I'll consult Gravel and the spokesman. How did it end up like this?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Oh! But—getting a little famous isn't so bad, either. I've been here a while, and you do get to see the same faces from time to time.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: With such frequent injuries, it seems like competing as a knight isn't much of an easy job.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: But—I did previously tend to an Infected who was seriously hurt, and I haven't seen him for the past few days. Who knows how his recovery's been going...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Do you mean Mr. Silverlamp Knight?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Right-right-right, and after I finished basic treatment, he got hauled off by a Knights Association person... I don't know where he's gone.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Ah, I see someone waving at me! I need to head over right away! Amiya, don't forget to ask what's going on with that for me!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: These Infected knights look... permanently exhausted, going by their faces.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Some may have won matches, gotten considerable prize money, but still can't muster their spirits at all.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's not like I've never seen this look before. It's just like fighting to the death has filled their entire lives to the point they could burst, and they can't bear even the slightest hope or optimism.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The Infected knight competitions... are simply treating the Infected as entertainment products.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm starting to understand a little, what Nearl is here for.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ah, come in.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (Doctor, are you always so busy in here?)

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}, about that meeting you mentioned last time—I've gotten it all set up and ready.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Oh? Am I interrupting yours and Miss Amiya's conversation?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's perfectly fine, Mr. Malkiewicz.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: A few medical corporations collaborating with Rhodes Island are deeply interested in your firm's services and technology. Of course, even with a mind for simple friendship, they'd still love to have dinner with you.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: However... if you'd allow me to warn you. If Miss Amiya is to participate... she is ultimately Infected, and I worry you'll be treated in unneeded ways.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's alright, I'm already used to it.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: My apologies.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: By the way, Dr. {@nickname}, here's the business magazine you mentioned before... I didn't expect you to take such an interest in Kazimierz's economic situation.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Do you plan to open a subsidiary in Kazimierz? I've heard your firm keeps a 'branch office' in our nation.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (D—Doctor, our branch office shouldn't have been officially communicated to the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi yet, right? Did they already... investigate their way to it?)

options: Just wanted to get an idea of the Chamber.
I did want to get a look into Kazimierz's situation.
Do you regard Rhodes Island well?

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: You've made the right choice.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: I myself only recently began to understand them, but if you truly want to figure out the 'General Chamber of Commerce,' you won't go wrong starting with the 'commerce' part.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Haha, if you do plan to start a business in the Grand Knight Territory someday, be sure to contact me. I'll find you the best team of lawyers for Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: To tell the truth, Rhodes Island's technology and corporate culture... do deeply move me.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: I'm not saying it out of politeness. I believe 90% of Kazimierz's citizens would agree the Infected form an issue, but the majority of the time, none of them want to solve it.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Rather than avoiding the problem via violence, there's 'treatment.' Yes, Oripathy is just an illness in the end, isn't it?

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: But...

options: Something seems to be worrying you.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: There was an accident in which an Infected passed away on the field, not long ago.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: I'm not casting judgment on this incident itself. I'm saying the force of public opinion is greater than we can imagine.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: I'm no professional at all, but I think of, and you understand better than me, an Infected dying from overcasting in the arena inviting uncontrollable danger, and how great that danger is—

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: —Despite it being, in my eyes, near-deliberate harassment, an unjust confrontation... the fact of the matter is, the barbs of the masses from far and wide are aimed at the Infected.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: I worry whether it might affect our cooperation... my Rhodes Islander friends.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mr. Malkiewicz.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's not the first time the Infected have been through something like this, and it won't be the last.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: In places beyond Kazimierz, what Infected go through far surpass what you've seen.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: A partner of mine, from before I was a spokesman, was once the Rose Paper Union's Executive Director of Publishing.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: I quickly came to recognize 'the terror of gossip,' Miss Amiya, Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Perhaps opinion as of late will impact your work. I'll do my best to placate the moods of the workers and those receiving treatment.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Malkiewicz.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: It's the least I can do.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: It seems I still have a little time today... Dr. {@nickname}, did we have an appointment prior?

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: If you're free, do let me tour you around Kazimierz a bit.

options: I'm not the only one who admires Kazimierz's splendor.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Of course, so long as the formalities and credentials are in hand, an Infected such as Miss Amiya is free to act as she wishes.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I—I'll be fine, I still need to check in with all our Medic Operators to—

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Appropriate rest is very important, Miss Amiya. Additionally, the patient who just arrived is the last for today.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Really?

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Well, then, we'll meet downstairs in ten minutes.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Malkiewicz has gotten real close to Rhodes Island lately. Oof, that's not good.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: The Board of Directors hasn't classified Rhodes Island as a target... which can only mean Darksteel has a different view of Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: The three of them have foresight a mile better than the average suits. How many years have they hung around in Kazimierz?

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: What's the point? They're still just the pawns of the K.G.C.C.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Sometimes, foresight means 'forget beating the rules that don't benefit you, you've gotta learn to use them, join them.'

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Yeah, of course the young bunch and the 'ooh, look at me, look at my glory' knights aren't gonna approve of that argument, but it's everywhere, and if you want the truth of society, there it is.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: What makes your theory so different from all those corporate employees?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: The difference is... we're strong enough.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Don't see the logic.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Haha, let's just get back to business. The Board's already made a decision vis-a-vis the Infected purge order.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: So soon?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: I told the people upstairs about the Infected knights' plans to riot, after all.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Make them realize in advance. Let them be aware 'the Grand Knight Territory is about to face an Infected attack.'

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: That's the only way we'll get any space made to operate.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: So, then...

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: We're still tidying a few Infected as appropriate.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Hmph, could've saved your breath from the start.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: We've gotta do what we've gotta do, and if we don't do it with enough smarts, we'll invite our own killers in.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: There sure aren't any heroes in Kazimierz. Look at the bustling street before us. Who'd waste the energy standing off with this city?

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: Kazimierz's champions—they still carry the people away in this day and age. *chuckle* Truly wondrous.

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: You want to say... it's because I'm old, don't you?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: I would never regard you in that matter.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Your Excellency, these documents are classified by the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi. Will handing them over to Rhodes Island...

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: I haven't reached senility yet.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: That wasn't my meaning.

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: ...Senomy.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: I hear... you never actually offered your patriarch your true name.

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: We simply 'have a hold on your name,' haven't yet earned your loyalty...

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Your Excellency, Grand Knight, I was sold as a slave into Kazimierz, no more.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: I'm deeply honored I could receive the appreciation of the master of the house, but how can someone like me have anything to do with the act of offering a true name?

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: ...I see.

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: You've been in contact with Rhodes Island for a time, now. How's it been?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: I believe myself to have already earned a... portion of Rhodes Island's trust.

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: That's not what I mind at all, Senomy. What I mind is, has Rhodes Island won your trust?

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: Campaign knights are servicemen. You're abiding strictly to your duties, fighting bravely for Kazimierz.

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: You're still so young. Why constrain your own mind?

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: All we can give the young is the kindling. It's up to you to light the fire.

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: You don't like Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: No... it's just...

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: If we suppose providing care to the Infected like that is 'justice,' then—what Kazimierz, the Adeptus have been doing for so long—how are we meant to we regard that?

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: Go and find out yourself. You've still got a long, long road ahead.

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: The Armorless Union's begun to move. I assume, before the Major hits fever pitch, they want to eliminate the Infected threat.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: —Do they really plan to hold a massacre inside the city?

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: They have cause to. The Infected are indeed planning an attack on the General Chamber's tower. That's not an easy thing to handle.

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: Margaret Nearl—she resembles her grandfather quite a bit.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: She's very unlikely to stay out of this.

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: She's also an exceptional case. Whether the Infected, or the Armorless, they hide outside of the rules drawn up by themselves, and so, suffer the cruelest struggles.

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: The Radiant Knight... has managed to pierce into this barrier. Pierce into the den of horror that calls itself the knight competitions.

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: The Nearls wouldn't raise an uneducated knight. By all rights, she should know she's doing no better than bailing water with a glass.

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: And so... the Adeptus decided to grant her one chance. One chance to humiliate the business suits, one chance to let the knights prove themselves.

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: They are going to give every ounce to support the Radiant Knight's championship bid.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Welcome! Welcome, one and all! Welcome to the Kazimierz National Arena, and welcome to the site of the Major today!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: I'm your old buddy Greatmouth Mob, honored to host this match you've all been waiting for!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Ooh, I've never seen passion swell as high as this—I've gotta tell you all some juicy data. The match hasn't even started, and the number of people watching has already cemented itself as this Major's highest yet!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: And at the same time! Over the match, we'll be drawing lots for ten lucky people here in the audience! These ten winners are going to get their hands on an assigned tie-in souvenir each!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: No time to waste, ready your greatest rounds of applause! Out of the legends of the ancient family comes history's youngest champion! Give a warm welcome—to—THE RADIANT KNIGHT! MAAAARGAREEEEEET NEAAAAAAARL!!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: The Radiant Knight Margaret Nearl, returning to the field with a celestial beauty! In just a few short weeks, she's seized qualification to join in on the Major—

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: And it doesn't end there! Today will see this Major's first clash of Grand Knight on Grand Knight! With the honor of 'the T, the H and the E' on their titles, that's all you need to hear to know what these knights are about!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Margaret Nearl, Nearl the Radiant Knight! Today, she faces her opponent, the light of elegance from Leithanien!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: She's been nominated for Most Popular Knight over and over, eighteen individual honors to her name—

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: And if that wasn't enough, her first ever competition, she beat Frost Skull Knight to become the greatest of dark horses! She was runner-up in the last Major's duels! Not to mention her popularity, an utterly uncontested number two in the nation!

steps.name: A Popcorn-Clutching Knight
steps.text: Dark horse? What's dark horse mean? Dark? Dark Knight? The Black Knight?

steps.name: An Audience Knight
steps.text: It just means someone really strong!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Her name—ooh, the red-hot crowd is already beginning to chant her name—welcome, THE CANDLE KNIGHT! VIVIAAANAAAAA DROOOOOOSTE!

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: Good evening, Radiant Knight.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Good evening.
The cacophony of voices seems to gradually abate, and in that moment, the two knights nod at each other.
The Candle Knight slowly lifts her hand.
Light and heat, weaving and twining in response to her title.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: Radiant Knight, are you proud of who you are?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: As a knight? Or as an Infected?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: As Margaret Nearl.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: Hm... a common answer.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: Were you aware? Truthfully, I was the bastard daughter of a Leithanian noble.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Oh...

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: There at the top of that spire, I couldn't even hear the human clamor of the city down below.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: I couldn't hear the peddlers market their wares, nor the cars roll across the surface. Every night, the darkness enveloped me, from each and every direction.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: However, my mother... would bring me, in secret, wax candles.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Wax... candles?

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: Electric lights tend to be easy to spot, don't they? And that noble household always kept so many ornamental candles around, no one would notice if a few went missing.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: By the candlelight, I would read. Poems, novels, prose from all nations. They were full of magic.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: In those days, I read a fair share of books.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: Books, depicting... knights.

a.text: 'Once the waves washed away, once glory and life together faded.'
'The world and all its beings fallen from zenith to nadir, becoming dust.'
'Once the forge belched its flames, once Catastrophe descended, once families and old friends all let this be forgotten.'
'The last knight upon this great land, all alone, faced the swells as dark as night and began to charge.'

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: ...A knight novel?

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: A fabricated romance, only meant to stir people's imaginations, correct?

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: Radiant Knight, since becoming a knight, what is it you've wanted to do?

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: And what should a knight do?

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: The two knights seem to be conversing in their pre-match moments! The atmosphere's so friendly, anyone would hate to shatter it!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: But in the end, a match is a match! Knights, to your positions please!

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: That was the identity I came to Kazimierz with, practically 'banished' to this nation. Simply so I could live on, I chose to become a knight.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: To be frank, when I realized that winning matches, earning popularity, was all it took to become 'a knight,' I was disappointed.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: And in these years, I've never felt much of anything genuine. As if my days making a living in Kazimierz—aren't even as rich as my time hidden in the spire.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: But you're different.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: When I came to Kazimierz, the Radiant Knight had already been banished. But as a knight, I'd always hear all kinds of anecdotes about you.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: You do invite curiosity. If you disdain the knight competitions of now, what goal do you pursue by participating? Is it simply to take this championship, prove something?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Back then, at the time, that was indeed my belief.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: If everyone's gazes had diverted from glory, I would go to where they focused most, and tell them all, the knights still remain.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: At the time?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: After I left Kazimierz, I traveled to many places. By no means was I always free from bewilderment—but by the end, I'd chosen my own justice, my own faith.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: To rescue the Infected?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Yes, but not that alone.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: So this is your definition of a knight?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: If you demand an answer... I once told my sister as much, and to this day, I've still never amended this notion.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: 'To be a knight is to be the noble light that illuminates the land.'

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: The Candle Knight and the Radiant Knight, then.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Now there's a match that'll light up every corner. Don't you think, V?

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Hey, old bones. Why've you been so out of sorts lately? What's wrong? Did that Nightzmora end up being your long-lost lovechild or what have you?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Spadaj, what the hell nonsense are you talking?!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Hold on, Maria's not here?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: She wouldn't miss her sister's match for the world. Should be right on her way.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: I'll go and look for her.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: Illuminate... the land.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: Not all people can illuminate the land, Radiant Knight. Most are but tiny candle-flames, barely enough to light the way on their own lives.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: The storm rocks us. In this age, a candle-flame is indistinct, the people have lost their selves, and what frightens me, is they aren't even conscious of it.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: Knowing this full well, why must you still—

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Are you doubting yourself? Viviana?

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: You call me by my name.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: That may be who you really are, the Candle Knight is no more than a title upon you.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: People's fates are not decided by their births, Viviana. In my view, you are an outstanding knight.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: ...Heheh.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: (Leithanian) If your faith truly is as unshakeable as the sun, allow such a meager candle-flame as myself...

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: (Leithanian) To try and wrest a moment of your rays.
